title: My Nail Salon
content: When my father died in Mid- 2018, I started coming here to the Mall. Short story is that my nail salon is in the basement, 2 escalators/ 4 sets of stairs down. There are usually some people, but it’s never as busy as the main floor. The lights are typically dim because most of the big stores down there simply closed. There is a long hallway ahead and then about 70-80ft, there is a right turn. And there is my salon! Right on the corner. Though they recognize me, I don’t get special treatment and often wait for other patrons to finish. I often recognize some of them, but only as people who also love this spa. Anyway, there is no single story here. I can get detailed nails, a pedicure, a neck massage, and the price and quality is always good. I feel comfortable there. So usually when I show up on the escalator, I go and see them. Upstairs from there is a hippy store. I want to go, but when my nails are done, I end up just outside, in a resort. I can’t leave any of it. But I’m perfectly ok with that?
